This product is ok.  In my opinion, you have to use a lot to notice you are even wearing it.... I wasn't thrilled it was a powder..  I was hoping for something creamy.  I guess that is my fault, i should have read or researched more.  Or maybe I am not using it right.  Who knows....

For some reason I thought this was going to be smaller than it was, imagine my surprise when I opened it up to see a fairly large pallet. I absolutely love the colors in this!!! Great product, evenly goes on skin... and a staple in my every day use.

I have been buying this palate for over a year and continue to love it! I have a fair skin tone and this matches great since it has several color options in the palate. I love it and will continue to buy this over and over again!

This contour set is probably for fairer skin since the darkest color is only slightly darker than my completion. you have to use a lot of powder to actually see any difference and it's not as pigmented as I would have like.
This GAGA pallete is good but I have found that It is hard to blend and the longer the day wears on it starts to turn more orange than tan. It is very pigmented.

reviews.t: A little dark but otherwise ok.
reviews.x: I'm still working on my contouring technique and bought this almost as practice. It works and made for a good experiment. However the colors are a little too dark for me as I'm very lightly complected and they run a little on the orangey-warm color side and I think something with more cool type colors with a slight blue base would look nicer. Was completely worth it for the experience and the price.

Overall I really like this palette, the colors were a bit lighter than the picture portrays but lighting is everything and I don't think the pictures were meant to be deceiving. They are super easy to apply and I have sensitive skin and haven't had an issue with my skin becoming irritated or anything so I'm very pleased with this! Will definitely be buying this again in the future!

reviews.t: Mostly for pale skin. (As far as I know)
reviews.x: As far as I know this palette works best for people who are light skinned. Every color except the white seemed to work very well. It was much larger than I expected and came in one piece with no breaks. This is absolutely perfect for beginners to contouring. Not only that but the powder form allows it to be a much faster routine.

My sister had ordered this product and I loved it so much, I ordered the palette for myself. However, the packaging was very thin and didn't provide enough protection. Also, the palette that arrived was not the same palette that's shown in the pictures or other product reviews. Disappointed and have started the return process.

It's pretty nice for the price and I love how BIG the pallet itself is. It's the same size at my tablet. Although the colors are not very pigmented. Especially the lighter ones. Can hardly tell it did anything. But the darker colors work nicely to set dark cream contouring.

I'm not good with makeup, but this worked well for me. It looked a bit dark or maybe I put on too much, but in a few minutes it looked fine. I looked fine for 5 hours without touching up, but took it off when I got home, so I don't know how it lasts much after that.

reviews.t: At first I was excited about this product because I ...
reviews.x: At first I was excited about this product because I saw how big the palettes were compared to what I thought they'd be but I could barely see the powder on my skin, no matter what brushes I used.
Pretty good for the low price. I wanted to try some contouring powders that were good for my very fair complexion without spending an arm and a leg on a higher end palette. This did the trick.
The contour colors are a little too warm toned for my liking, and the fourth color was broken when it came, but its not a loss, it was my skin color anyways. Other than that, great product.
